integrity: Complete normal-form proof is symbolic; verifier performs finite nonexhaustive checks; no independent mathematical audit performed.
scientific_limitations: Quotient exactly two of ordinary numerical semigroup O_m with m>=2; ranks are relative to 2O_m, not ordinary embedding dimensions. General quotient fibers, larger divisors, and nonordinary targets not claimed. General fixed-quotient description and rank-one cases are prior knowledge; minimum genus was known in 2015. Unindexed equivalent counts remain a priority risk.
title: Boolean layers and exact genus–rank counts for doubles of ordinary numerical semigroups
